source_window.dataset_title: Local Land Charges Register / Search for local land charges
source_window.resource_title: Official public terms for Local Land Charges search inputs, access and boundary outputs
source_window.data_date: Official HM Land Registry terms page accessed 2026-10-06
source_window.license: Terms-page content is available under Open Government Licence v3.0 except where stated; underlying service information is subject to Crown copyright/database rights and Ordnance Survey/third-party terms.

field_evidence.search_inputs: HM Land Registry states the Local Land Charges service can search by postcode, address or partial address, map, title number, coordinates or INSPIRE ID.
field_evidence.personal_search: The terms page states a personal search is free and allows inspection of the Local Land Charges register.
field_evidence.official_search_geometry: The official search includes a search boundary/area on a map and local land charge boundary.
field_evidence.account_gate: The terms page states an account must be created to access the search service.
field_evidence.target_result_limit: The public/no-login terms page does not return a Forge Cottage TN25 7JX target result, title number, INSPIRE ID, or registered-title polygon.
field_evidence.geometry_limit: Search-area and local-land-charge boundaries are local-land-charge/search extents, not a registered-title cadastral parcel polygon.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Without a target-specific authoritative registered-title/title-boundary polygon, no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official Search for local land charges service supports searches by postcode, address/partial address, map, title number, coordinates or INSPIRE ID, but an account is required to access the search service. The unused public/no-login terms window therefore does not return a Forge Cottage TN25 7JX search result, title number, INSPIRE ID or registered-title/index-polygon geometry. The service's search-area and local-land-charge boundaries are charge/search extents, not the canonical registered-title parcel required by this family. Local OpenCode or another authoritative title workflow must bind the exact target registered-title/title-boundary polygon; after canonical bbox is bound, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from Kent County Council Historic Environment Record map semantics to HM Land Registry's Local Land Charges search service. This source window was already opened on a stale fork and is transplanted onto the authoritative lineage without re-querying it. The terms page is official and public/no-login and documents postcode/address/title-number/coordinate/INSPIRE-ID search capability, but the actual search service requires an account. No target-specific Forge Cottage result is exposed in this public window. Any local-land-charge or search-area geometry would represent a restriction/search extent rather than the registered-title cadastral parcel, so it is not promoted. No canonical parcel ID, polygon or bbox is inferred; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
